newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH GARMENT MAKERS SURGE AMID FLAT MARKET.
newsitem.headline: POLISH GARMENT MAKERS SURGE AMID FLAT MARKET.

text.p: Polish garment makers Wolczanka, Vistula and Prochnik were all among the main market's top gainers on Monday, as the sector looked relatively undervalued, traders said.
The three firms rose 10 percent, 8.1 percent and 5.6 percent respectively, with Vistula the most active in a 4.8-million-zloty turnover.
"The sector looks relatively undervalued after its poor performance on the bourse last year, and could be rising the way construction firms recently did after a weaker 1996," one trader said.
But analysts said the firms did not look fundamentally sound enough to sustain a significant growth trend.
